creation: Original hand-authored SVG schematic created for this lesson; no patient image, external image, or generative image model used.
clinicalUse: Non-diagnostic conceptual graphic. It marks reporting locations only; anatomy is simplified and not to scale. It must not be used to infer disease, lesion distribution, nodal status, metastasis, or stage.

alt.de: Nichtdiagnostische Orientierungsskizze: Lungenherd, Hilus und Mediastinum, Pleura sowie Nebennieren als getrennte Orte der Befundbeschreibung; keine CT-Aufnahme.
alt.en: Non-diagnostic orientation schematic: lung lesion, hilum and mediastinum, pleura, and adrenals as separate reporting locations; not a CT image.
